Emphasis Electives
Emphasis Electives (12 credits required): Approved courses include ACCTG 220, 230; AFS 101, 435, 201, 401; CROP SCI/HORT 102; ECONS 101, 102, 351; ENGLISH 402 [M] or 403 [M]; ENTOM 101, 150;  HBM 258; MGMT 301; MKTG 360; SOIL SCI 101; or VIT ENOL 113; or as approved by  advisor.

CHEM 470 OR MBIOS 303

MBIOS 101, or MBIOS 304 and 305

Complete Writing Portfolio

FS 350

FS 416

Food Science Electives
Food Science Electives (minimum 12 credits, but additional FS courses count towards Emphasis electives):  Approved courses include FS 201, 301, 304, 329, 401, 402, 405, 406, 407, 409, 429, 430, 436, 440, 464, 465, 466, 475, 495, 496, 499, or as approved by advisor.

FS 443 [M]

FS 460

FS 461 [M]

FS 470

FS 489 [CAPS]

A student may be admitted to the Food Science – General Option major upon making their intention known to the department.

The general option under the food science major is for the student interested in the science of food processing, quality, safety and product development.  Students gain practical training in the application of chemistry and microbiology to the processing of foods.
